docker.io/dolthub/dolt-mcp:0.3.7.overview:
## Dolt MCP Server

The dolt-mcp-server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows AI assistants and agents to interact directly with Dolt, a SQL database with built-in Git-style version control. It facilitates AI-driven workflows including querying data, inspecting schema changes, creating and managing branches, reviewing diffs, and analyzing historical data — all within a unified interface. It's particularly valuable for data analysis, auditing, experimentation, and collaborative workflows requiring tracking and understanding of data changes over time.
